 (individually, or in the case of joint buyers , collectively referred to as “ Buyer ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, n ominees, successors-in-interest, permitted transferees and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART . 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled “ ZAMEEN ACE MALL ”, comprising of inter alia commercial shops, hotel apartments and residential apartments located at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA, Islamabad (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and is desirous to purchase the commercial shop as described in the Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”); and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer will sell the rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement , along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit , all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions; 
 Appendix A: Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: List of Material s ; 
 Any other document incorporated by reference in this Agreement . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory . In the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3. 4 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Building / Community 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s / occupant’s rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the all Purchased Units. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 CAM Charges means the amount payable by the Buyer for the purpose of Common Area s m aintenance (“ CAM ”) including but not limited to operational management, administration, maintenance , upkeep , replacement (where required) and security of the Common Areas, Common Facilities and p arking area . 
 
 CAM Charges Advance means the CAM Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance at the time of Completion and in accordance with Clause 3.1 ( ii ) of the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Unit s, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system , lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features (if any) , installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security systems , pumps, firefighting system s , ventilation fans, common area furnishings, tube-well motors, gym (if any) , swimming pool (if any) , mini cinema (if any) , clubhouse/restaurant (if any) , improvements and other common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Purchased Unit s and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit . 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion Date or Estimated Completion Date 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause s 3 (Payment) and 5 (Construction and Possession of Purchased Unit ) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project. 
 
 Developer means Z UI I NVESTMENTS with its office on the 3 rd Floor, Pearl One 94-B/I, MM Alam Rd, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing. 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including but not limited to the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Date of Possession means t he date , notified by the Developer in writing to the Buyer upon which the Buyer is obligated to take physical possession of the Unit in accordance with Clause 5. 3 . 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 4 .1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Fit-Out Manual means the manual prepared and issued by the Developer and/or the Management Company, as may be amended from time to time, setting out the standards, specifications, conditions, and approval processes applicable to all interior works, alterations, and installations within the Unit. The Fit-Out Manual shall be binding on all Buyers and/or occupants, and no fit-out works may be undertaken without full compliance with its requirements and the prior written approval of the Developer. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause 3. 4 , include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means next of kin or any other person (18 years or above) nominated by the Buyer in Schedule A to facilitate the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell and/or with respect to the Purchased Unit , to the Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the use of the Buyer or occupants of the Purchased Unit in accordance with the Building/Community Rules . 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement to Sell, setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer. 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Purchased Unit as per the Purchased Unit type specified in the Description of the Purchased Unit , strictly in accordance with the Building/Community Rules and the Fit-Out Manual . 
 
 Project means the real estate project, named and styled as ‘ Z AMEEN ACE MALL ’ , being constructed and developed by the Developer at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, DHA, Islamabad. 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax) including Component Materials, White Goods (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and in such instalments , as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell, as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause 9 .2 and any Adjusted Amount in terms of Clause 3. 4 of the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed and finished residential apartment, hotel apartment, commercial shop, or any other type of unit as specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Other Unit (s) means any one or more residential apartment , hotel apartment, commercial shops , or any other types of units in the Project, other than the Purchased Unit. 
 
 White Goods means the household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit(s), as specified in Table A listed in Appendix C. These appliances are provided exclusively in residential units and are not included in any commercial shop, office, kiosk, or other types of units.

 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest of the Developer therein, for a total sale consideration equal to the Purchase Price strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 2.2 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only the title of the Purchased Unit shall be transferred to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no rights, title or interest in the Project other than the limited permission to access and enjoy the Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space as expressly provided herein and subject to specific terms and conditions as may be stipulated from time to time . For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall at all times have all rights, title and interest with respect to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Space, roof and exterior walls , including inter alia the sole discretion to make any change to the Common Areas, as well as add or discontinue any Common Facilities. 
 
 2.3 That it is the essence of this Agreement that the Buyer shall , o n the Completion Date or as and when communicated by the Developer, enter into and execute such documents and agreements, as mentioned in the terms and conditions of this Agreement , including the CAM Agreement (“ CAM Agreement ”) , with the Developer or the Management Company or any other party/company in charge of the maintenance and management of the Project, as the case may be. 
 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 Under and pursuant to this Agreement , the Buyer is liable to fulfil all of her/his payment obligations as and when due without any delay whatsoever, including but not limited to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date, as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement, along with any applicable Adjusted Amount; 
 
 Payment of CAM Charges Advance to be paid in advance for twelve (12) months on or before the Completion Date; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection charges, as per applicable laws, as and when due; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable taxes, fees, stamp duties, levies (if any) related to the Purchased Unit and its transfer as per Clause 4 below; and 
 
 Fulfilment of any other payment obligation whatsoever of the Buyer under this Agreement as per the applicable Due Date. 
 
 The Developer’s obligation to construct, complete and transfer the title of the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer shall be conditional upon the Buyer fulfilling her/his payment obligations under Clause 3.1 above. 
 
 The Buyer understands and agrees that the Purchase Price does not include any costs associated with the transferring and recording of any rights in the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale/purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) as envisaged under Clause 3.1 (i v ) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall remain fixed under the Agreement except in the event of any unforeseeable events arising that are not in control of the Developer (hereinafter “ Unforeseeable Event ”) including but not limited to ( i ) any increase in the prevailing market rates of White Goods and Component Material s including but not limited to those specified in Appendix C appended to this Agreement ; (ii) any change in the rates of the Component Material s , as notified by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, State Bank of Pakistan, vide the price indices (including, without limitation, as a result of fluctuation in the FOREX rates); (iii) any increase in the bill of quantities; (iv) any change in the Project design and layouts, and/or (v) any change in the applicable taxes or levy of any additional tax with respect to the Project . Any change in the Purchase Price due to an Unforeseeable Event shall be referred to as the “ Adjusted Amount ”. The Adjusted Amount shall be calculated and adjusted in the Purchase Price from time to time, in such manner and at such time as communicated by the Developer. The Developer shall make a reasonable effort that the Purchase Price remains unaffected and ensure that any adjustments to the Purchase Price are fair and reasonable . 
 
 The adjustment in the Purchase Price under Clause 3. 4 shall only be to the extent of an increase in the price of Component Materials , White Goods and applicable taxes, and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount on the Due Date prescribed by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/or Adjusted Amount on its Due Date, without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges, conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise, all of which shall be borne by the Buyer. The Instalment Payment/Adjusted Amount shall be deposited by the Buyer in the Developer’s account, the details of which shall be communicated by the Developer to the Buyer in writing or via email, on or before the relevant Due Date. The Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of the Agreement, entitling the Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 1 2 .

 In addition to other obligations of the Buyer to make payments and in accordance with Clause 2 .3 above , the Buyer shall also pay CAM Charges to the Management Company in accordance with the CAM Agreement starting from the Completion Date, even if the Unit is lying vacant .  The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that any payments made by the Buyer under this Agreement shall be utilised, in order of precedence, towards late payment charges (if any), any charges or expenses borne by the Developer in relation to the enforcement of this Agreement, and lastly the relevant Instalment Payment due along with any applicable taxes. 
 
 TAXES 
 
 The Buyer shall be solely responsible for all taxes, duties, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities and other charges with respect to the Purchased Unit . To the extent any payment of any such taxes, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities or other charges are paid by the Developer, in the Developer’s absolute discretion, on behalf of the Buyer , the same shall be reimbursed by the Buyer as and when demanded by the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer agrees to pay all taxes and assessments in respect of the Purchased Unit from the Completion Date. 
 
 CONSTRUCTION AND POSSESSION OF UNIT 
 
 It is agreed and understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date represents the date by which it is presently expected that the Project will be completed, and the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover to the Buyer. Whereas the Completion Date represents the actual date by which the Project is completed and the Purchased Unit is ready for handover to the Buyer. It is further understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date may change in the event of delay in construction works as a result of any Unforeseeable Event (as defined in Clause 3. 4 above) occurring, Event of Force Majeure arising and/or delay in payments by the Buyer under this Agreement. 
 
 The Developer shall issue the Completion Notice to the Buyer communicating the Completion Date and informing the Buyer to make all outstanding payments, under the Agreement, in order for the possession of the Purchased Unit to be delivered to the Buyer. The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to (but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. The Instalment Payment due on possession, as indicated in the Payment Plan, shall, under Clause 5.2, be payable by the Buyer as and when communicated by the Developer . Subject to the Buyer having fully performed his/her obligations under the Agreement and clearing all required payment(s), charges and taxes under provisions of the Agreement , the Developer shall issue a notice conveying the Date of Possession to the Buyer of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 On the Date of Possession , subject to the Buyer having completed all applicable transfer formalities, including payment of all transfer fees, costs, charges , stamp duty etc . and the terms of this Agreement, the Developer shall transfer vacant possession of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and issue the allotment letter in favour of the Buyer. The Developer shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer, including issuance of NOC for recording of Buyer’s rights in the Purchased Unit in the relevant department/revenue record, if requested by the Buyer. The Developer shall not be obliged to hand over possession of the Purchased Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under the Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of the Buyer’s rights in the relevant department/revenue record shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. 
 
 The Developer shall, to the extent possible, assign to the Buyer the benefit of any valid manufacturers’ warranties at th e time of Completion Date , in respect of any White Goods provided in the Purchased Unit under this Agreement. The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty in this regard, including with respect to the fitness for use or quality of any White Goods and has relied on the manufacturers ’ /suppliers ’ representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all White Goods in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of the same, and the Developer shall have no liability thereof , including but not limited to any extension in the warranty periods. 
 
 Upon completion of the Project and handover of all units to the respective buyers, the Developer, if approved by a majority of the buyers, shall assist in facilitating the process of obtaining insurance for the Project. Any such insurance shall be procured solely at the cost and responsibility of the buyers and may, where applicable, be included in the CAM Charges. In the event of any unforeseen incident, the handling of claims and remedies shall be governed exclusively by the terms of such insurance and the applicable procedures of the relevant authorities. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall only facilitate and shall have no obligation or liability to arrange or maintain any insurance coverage for the Project after its completion and handover. 
 In the event that the Buyer fails to take over possession of the Purchased Unit on the Date of Possession , for any reason, all risks, responsibilities, and obligations, including but not limited to any damages to the Purchased Unit, shall transfer to the Buyer from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Purchased Unit shall be transferred with actual possession. In addition, the Buyer shall be obligated to pay the CAM Charges and a monthly fee for each month the possession is delayed beyond the D ate of P ossession . 
 
 
 The Buyer shall pay, as and when due and without delay, all costs and charges for electricity, water and meter installation and connections charges, and failure to do so will be a default under this Agreement. The Developer shall facilitate the Buyer to obtain permanent electricity, water and meter connections for the Purchased Unit on or before the Completion Date, subject to the Buyer having fulfilled all of his/her obligations hereunder. For the avoidance of doubt, the Buyer shall be solely responsible and liable for any damage to, tampering with, or faults caused to the installed utility meters. 
 
 Subject to Clause 5 .2 above, the Buyer shall take actual possession of the Purchased Unit within thirty (30) days of the Completion Date. In the event the Buyer fails to make the relevant payments as required under Clause 3.1 or otherwise to take possession of the Purchased Unit within said thirty (30) days of the Completion Date, the Buyer shall, inter alia , be responsible for such additional charge(s) as the Developer deems fit to cover its administration and service costs in order to manage and maintain the Purchased Unit . Furthermore, the Buyer shall be liable to pay the CAM Charges and for all risk and costs applicable to the Purchased Unit as and from the Completion Date (including loss of or damage to the Purchased Unit or any part thereof). 
 
 BUYER’S COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer covenants, represents, undertakes or warrants as under: 
 
 The Buyer has the necessary legal capacity and authority to purchase the Purchased Unit ; and 
 
 The Purchased Unit will be used only for the Permitted Use. 
 
 The Buyer warrants that the Buyer shall and shall procure that any Third Party shall: 
 
 act strictly in complete compliance with this Agreement , the CAM Agreement, and the Building/Community Rules and the Fit-Out Manual including, inter alia , any policy with respect to the  resale and transfer of the Purchased Unit and all other rules and regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit , and to make all payments of duties, taxes, levies and charges whatsoever as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit or the Buyer’s ownership thereof or other rights therein. 
 
 not lease, assign, mortgage, encumber or hypothecate any interest in the Purchased Unit without the prior written approval of the Developer and/or Management Company (which may be withheld or conditioned at its sole discretion). For the avoidance of doubt, any disposition of interest in terms of this sub-clause 6.2 (ii) without the prior written approval of the Developer and/or Management Company shall be void and shall constitute a material breach of contract; 
 
 execute a CAM Agreement and such other document s in favour of the Management Company simultaneously at the time of execution of this Agreement and/or on or before the Completion Date as specified by the Developer, ensuring timely payment of CAM Charges to the Management Company, determined as per fair market rates, relating to the use and upkeep of the Common Areas, Common Facilities and/or Parking Space . For the avoidance of doubt, the CAM Charges shall be applicable even if the Unit is lying vacant or unoccupied by the Buyer ; 
 
 permit the Management Company, and its employees, representatives and agents at all reasonable times to enter the Purchased Unit to carry out its duties; 
 
 not do anything in the Purchased Unit or Project which may be or become a security hazard, nuisance, annoyance, disturbance, inconvenience or cause damage to the Common Area and Common Facilities or to the other people occupying/using any Other Purchased Unit s in the Project and will ensure that the Purchased Unit , the Common Areas and Common Facilities are kept clean; 
 
 not use the Purchased Unit for any illegal, unlawful or immoral act or purpose and shall not store inflammable or hazardous material or any material forbidden by law in the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 not do or cause to be done any acts, deeds or things that in any manner whatsoever slander or defame the Project, the Developer, its/their affiliates, executives, employees, representatives or agents; 
 
 comply in all respects with the provisions of all laws, decrees, regulations and the Building/Community Rules , including the rules of and requirements of any Competent Authority in relation to the Purchased Unit or anything done in the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 pay all charges (including meter connection charges relating to the Purchased Unit ) for water, electricity, sewage, telephone/cables and other services provided to the Purchased Unit , maintenance fees and other similar levies that may be imposed or levied with respect to the Purchased Unit from the Completion Date; 
 
 not make any partitions, alterations, additions, or attachments of any nature whatsoever in the Purchased Unit , Common Areas or Facilities or to the Project without the Developer’s and/or the Management Company’s written consent in advance, and that the Buyer will pay such administration charges to the Developer or the Management Company as may be demanded for vetting plans in respect of such partitions, alterations, attachments or additions; 
 
 understands and acknowledges that the Buyer’s obligations under the Agreement shall continue beyond the Completion Date; 
 
 undertakes to maintain insurance over the Purchased Unit as may be prescribed in the Building/Community Rules; 
 
 ensures and undertakes that no graffiti, signboard, advertisement, or logo is made, posted or attached on the outside/exterior walls of the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 not keep or store in the Purchased Unit or in the Common Areas, articles of heavy load or size which may damage the Purchased Unit or create nuisance of any kind for other occupants; 
 
 not place or store any equipment or goods, of any kind whatsoever, in the balconies and the terraces or window displays of the Purchased Unit which is not in accordance with the Building/Community Rules, may damage them, adversely affect the façade of the Purchased Unit or Project or endanger other occupants . The Buyer is also not allowed to install air conditioning outdoor units on balconies, or utilize the se areas in any manner restricted by the Developer or the Management Company; 
 
 not alter the aesthetic view of the Purchased Unit or the Project. The Buyer shall maintain, at all times, the structure of the Purchased Unit in such a state of repair and condition which provides structural support, protection and design to the Project, and not harm or damage the Project in any manner; and 
 
 not use the Purchased Unit or Project or any part thereof for any commercial activity of any kind at any time other than in accordance with the Permitted Use. In case of breach, the Developer or the Management Company may take such actions in terms of the Building/Community Rules or reasonable legal action to prevent or halt such activity or take any other action in accordance with the Building/Community Rules and applicable laws. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands and accepts the Buyer shall be liable to pay for any damage caused to the structure, material, fittings and fixtures of Other Units or the Common Areas and Common Facilities including, inter alia, mechanical, plumbing and electrical works, where the damage is caused by normal wear and tear, an Event of Force Majeure or where there is breakage or accidental damage caused or contributed to by any act or omission of the Buyer, occupant or visitor of the Purchased Unit. The Buyer shall also be liable for any personal injury sustained by occupants, visitors, or third parties resulting from any act or omission of the Buyer, occupant or visitor of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer shall pay CAM Charges to the Management Company in a timely manner, which shall be payable even if the Purchased Unit is lying vacant. All other regulations imposed by the Management Company or any association of owners or a Competent Authority in the present and in future will form a part of the Agreement. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands, and accepts that certain Common Facilities, including but not limited to the gym (if any), swimming pool (if any), clubhouse (if any), and mini cinema (if any) provided within the Project, are intended for the shared enjoyment of all occupants. To help ensure a fair and pleasant experience, the Management Company shall implement reasonable usage guidelines for accessing such facilities. The Buyer further understands and agrees that, as some of these facilities may involve higher operational and maintenance costs, the Management Company may apply an access charge. For the sake of clarity, the payment of CAM Charges shall not confer an automatic right to access such facilities. The Buyer also acknowledges that the Management Company may, from time to time, revise access procedures, usage guidelines, or charges as deemed appropriate to ensure effective management and an enjoyable environment for all occupants. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands and accepts that in addition to the CAM Charges, the Buyer understands that various Common Facilities and Common Areas, including, inter alia , elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, may require major repair or replacement, which shall be charged on pro-rata basis to all the occupants of the Project, including the Buyer. The Buyer accepts to pay the aforesaid amounts as and when required by the Management Company. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that the Fit-Out Manual constitutes an integral part of this Agreement and agrees to be fully bound by its provisions. No fit-out works, alterations, or installations may be undertaken within the Unit except in strict conformity with the Fit-Out Manual and subject to the Developer’s/Management Company’s prior written approval. The Developer/Management Company shall have the sole and absolute discretion to review, approve, supervise, suspend, or require modification or removal of any fit-out works at the entire cost and risk of the Buyer/occupant in the event of any non-compliance with the Fit-Out Manual. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands and accepts that the Developer shall have the sole authority and discretion to frame the Building/Community Rules. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that the Developer shall construct the infrastructure relating to the Project including boundary walls, roads, lighting, walkways, lobbies, hallways and landscaping substantively in accordance with the Developer’s overall development plan for infrastructure and the Buyer shall have no objection to it. 
 
 The Buyer agrees not to modify, add or remove any part of the exterior and/or interior of the Purchased Unit or construct any additional improvements in the Purchased Unit without the prior written consent of the Developer. 
 
 Buyer hereby represents and warrants that the Buyer shall not mortgage or create any other kind of lien, charge, encumbrance, etc on the  Purchased Unit without the prior written consent from the Developer or the Management Company. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and declares that all the statements made and information provided by the Buyer in the Agreement are true and correct. 
 
 TRANSFER AND RESALE BY THE BUYER 
 
 In the event that after transfer and possession of the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer, the Buyer intends to sell the Purchased Unit to any other person (hereinafter referred to as the “ Third Party ” for the purpose of this Clause 7 .1), the sale of the Purchased Unit to such Third Party shall not be permitted unless an NOC for sale is obtained by the Buyer from the Developer in advance, upon obtaining which all rights, title and interest in the Purchased Unit may be transferred from the Buyer to the Third Party in the relevant department/revenue record/land registry (if required), costs whereof will be in addition to any applicable transfer charges. The Buyer shall ensure that such Third Party does and executes all such acts, deeds and things as required by the Developer or under law for the sale, transfer and conveyance of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 The Buyer agrees and acknowledges that, if the Buyer intends to sell the Purchased Unit prior to the Completion Date, the Developer shall have the first right to buyback the Purchased Unit from the Buyer on such terms and conditions as are mutually agreed between the Parties in writing. 
 
 Subject to Clause 7 .2, the Buyer agrees and acknowledges that, prior to the allotment of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, no sale, assignment, transfer, lease or other disposition of any interest in the Purchased Unit in favour of any third party (hereinafter referred to as the “Transfer” for the purpose of this Clause 7 .3) shall be valid unless: 
 
 An amount equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Purchase Price has been paid by the Buyer to the Developer in clear funds; 
 
 The Buyer obtains an NOC from the Developer for the Transfer and completes all necessary documentation required; 
 
 Transfer charges of one percent (1%) of the Purchase Price, along with all fees, relevant Taxes, duties, and charges (including stamp duties and registration charges) or any other applicable fee have been paid in respect of the Transfer by the Buyer; 
 
 All payments due as at the proposed date of the Transfer, including any CAM Charges, have been paid in full to the Developer, Management Company and any Competent Authorities to their satisfaction; and 
 
 The transferee of the Purchased Unit has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by the Agreement, the agreement with the Management Company, and has signed a letter of adherence (or such other document) in relation thereto as may be prescribed by the Developer and/or the Management Company with respect to the Transfer. 
 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that there may be additional terms and conditions applicable with respect to the Transfer from time to time and the Buyer shall be responsible for reviewing and informing himself of the process of Transfer from the Developer before initiating such Transfer. 
 
 The Developer may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under the Agreement or with respect to the Project to any person or party, without giving any notice to the Buyer, and the Buyer hereby consents to any such assignment or transfer. 
 
 PARKING SPACE 
 
 The Developer will allocate a Parking Space to the Buyer with respect to the Purchased Unit in accordance with the Building/Community Rules , the exact location of which shall be identified by the Developer on the Date of Possession . The Buyer acknowledges that the Buyer only has permission to access and use the Parking Space and has no legal rights, title and/or interest in the allocated Parking Space, except to the extent specified in th e Building/Community Rules and/or the right to transfer or sub-let or otherwise dispose of the Parking Space. 
 
 MODIFICATIONS TO THE UNIT 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that the area and specifications of the Purchased Unit , as shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan and the Description of Purchased Unit is an approximation only and acknowledges that the actual floor area may vary from the area as stated in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that for the purposes of the Agreement, the total area is measured from the exterior face of the exterior wall, middle of the unit demising walls and exterior face of the corridor walls and includes all balconies and terraces. If the actual total area as determined by the Developer’s engineer is more or less than the represented total area by more than two percent (2%), the Purchase Price will be adjusted by an amount equal to the variance above two percent (2%). For the avoidance of doubt, no adjustment will be made to the Purchase Price if the total area is increased or is reduced by less than two percent (2%). 
 
 The Developer shall endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Project and Purchased Unit as per this Agreement. However, the construction of the Project and the Purchased Unit may be affected according to the plans/specifications approved by the Competent Authorities. Similar quality will be provided for any substituted items pertaining to the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, colours, materials, finishes, equipment, fixtures and specifications of the Purchased Unit . The Buyer shall be consulted in the event that any material change varies by more than ten percent (10%). 
 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that internal structural changes to the Purchased Unit shall not be permitted without the prior written approval of the Management Company or building management. For the avoidance of doubt, the Buyer shall not under any circumstances whatsoever be permitted to affect any change to the exterior of the Purchased Unit including, inter alia , the colour scheme, design of external walls, and/or layout in relation thereto and installing any projections, hooks or nails, etc. 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE DEVELOPER 
 
 In the event that the Developer fails to deliver possession of the Purchased Unit within [•] [(•)] months from the Estimated Completion Date, and provided that the Buyer has duly fulfilled all payment obligations under this Agreement without default, the Developer shall pay the Buyer a guaranteed monthly rental at an annual rate of six percent (6%) of the Purchase Price until the Completion Date. Notwithstanding the foregoing, this provision shall not be applicable if the delay is due to circumstances beyond the Developer’s control, as specified in Clause 14. 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE BUYER AND DEFAULTING PENALTY 
 
 If the Buyer fails to pay any Instalment Payment or any other payments , in full or in part, due under the Agreement to the Developer, the Management Company or to any Competent Authority (as the case may be) , within thirty (30) days of its Due Date, then the Developer may impose late payment charges at the rate of two percent (2%) per month from the Due Date of the Instalment Payment , and in case of CAM Charges or any other outstanding payment due under the Agreement the late payment charges shall be charge d at the rate prescribed by the Developer or the Management Company as the case may be . Any d elay exceeding sixty (60) days from the relevant Due Date shall be treated as a material default by the Buyer and the Developer will be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 1 2 below. 
 
 If the Buyer fails to tak e physical possession of the Purchased Unit for a period exceeding sixty (60) days from the Date of Possession, such delay or failure shall constitute a material breach of this Agreement. In such cases, the Developer shall be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 1 2 below . 
 
 Joint b uyers shall, jointly and individually, be responsible to fulfil and discharge all the obligations hereinabove mentioned. Upon breach of any of the conditions of the Agreement by any one or all of them, the Developer may resort to any legal means, in terms of the breach, against any one or all of the joint b uyers (as the Developer may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 The Parties hereby agree and acknowledge that the late payment charges stated in the Agreement do not constitute a penalty and are a genuine pre-estimate of the losses suffered by the Developer. 
 
 TERMINATION OF AGREEMENT AND CANCELLATION OF SALE 
 
 In the event that the Buyer has failed to fulfil its obligations under Clause 6 or any payment obligations under Clause 1 1 of the Agreement (including payment of late payment charges ), the Developer may serve a written notice of default to the Buyer for not less than seven (7) days. The Buyer shall be under an obligation to remedy the default within the time stipulated in the notice of default. However, if the default persists and is not cured by the Buyer within the time stipulated, the Developer may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect by serving a written notice of termination . Upon termination , all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause 1 3 .2 and subject to deductions specified therein. For the avoidance of doubt, no payment from the Buyer shall be accepted after the date of notice of termination . H owever, in the event the Buyer deposits a payment after the date of termination it shall be refunded in accordance with Clause 1 3 .2 and shall not be considered or deemed in any manner whatsoever a waiver of the Developer’s right to terminate the Agreement . 
 
 In the event that the Buyer has failed to take physical possession of the Purchased Unit under Clause 1 1 .2 , the Developer may serve a written notice of default to the Buyer for not less than thirty (30) days. The Buyer shall be under an obligation to remedy such default within the time stipulated in the notice of default. However, if the default persists and is not cured by the Buyer within the time stipulated, the Developer may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect by serving a written notice of termination. Upon termination, all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause 1 3 .2 and subject to deductions specified therein. Any forbearance by the Developer in exercising its right of termination shall not be considered or deemed in any manner whatsoever a waiver of the Developer’s right to terminate the Agreement. 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Developer may at any time terminate the Agreement in the event that any statement, representation, warranty or information provided by the Buyer to the Developer under this Agreement is found to be materially incorrect or false by serving a notice in writing to the Buyer. Upon termination , all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause 1 3 .2 and subject to such deductions as specified therein. 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 1 0 .1, the Buyer may serve a written notice of default to the Developer for not less than thirty ( 30 ) days. The Developer shall be under an obligation to remedy the default within the time stipulated in the notice of default. However, if the default persists and is not cured by the Developer within the time stipulated, the Buyer may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect by serving a written notice of termination . Upon termination , all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause 1 3 .2 and subject to deductions specified therein. For the avoidance of dou bt, the right of termination under this C lause 1 2 . 4 shall be deemed null and void if the Payment Plan for the Unit extends beyond the Completion Date. 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, either Party may terminate the Agreement at any time with immediate effect , by notifying the other Party in writing in accordance with Clause 1 8 .1 below . 
 
 The Buyer understands, acknowledges and confirms that upon the termination of the Agreement for any reason whatsoever, the Buyer shall have no rights, title, claim, benefit or interest with respect to the Purchased Unit on and from the date of termination. 
 
 CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION 
 
 Subject to Clause 1 3 .3, upon termination of the Agreement, any refund of payments due to the Buyer shall be paid: 
 
 If the Agreement is terminated under Clause 1 2 .1 or 1 2 .2, upon resale of the Purchased Unit or after completion of the Project; or 
 
 If the Agreement is terminated for any other reason whatsoever, within six (6) months of termination or upon resale of the Purchased Unit , whichever comes later . 
 
 Upon termination of the Agreement , refund of Instalment Payments by the Developer to the Buyer shall be subject to the following deductions: 
 
 cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price . Provided that no cancellation charges will be deducted in the event of termination by the Buyer as a result of a  delay in completion/handing over of possession by the Developer in accordance with the terms of this Agreement ; 
 
 l ate payment charges due under Clause 1 1 above (if any); and 
 
 and any other adjustments, charge s or cost s payable by the Buyer under the Agreement (if any). 
 
 Provided that any refund shall be subject to deduction of any difference between the Purchase Price and the market price of the Purchased Unit (as determined by the Developer in its absolute discretion) at the time of termination hereof in the event that the latter is lower . 
 
 Provided further that i n the event of any shortfall, the Buyer shall be liable to pay the shortfall amount to the Developer without any delay whatsoever. 
 
 Upon termination of the Agreement, t he Buyer shall deliver to the Developer all original documents, acknowledgements of receipt and any other correspondence under the Agreement, including without limitation the Agreement itself , as well as complete all necessary formalities with respect to the termination of the Agreement . 
 
 The Buyer agrees and acknowledges that it is the sole responsibility of the Buyer to collect the refund of under Clause 1 2 from the Developer’s office during office hours and that the Developer shall not in any manner whatsoever be liable in this regard including inter alia with respect to any delay or failure on the part of the Buyer to collect the refund. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure" refers to any event or occurrence beyond the Developer’s control, including but not limited to natural disasters such as fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm, or any other act of God; government actions such as war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power, confiscation, nationalization, requisition, acts of terrorism, or destruction or damage to property by order of any government, public, local, or other competent authority, including government sanctions, embargoes, or similar actions. It also includes labour disputes such as strikes, lockouts, or boycotts; failures or interruptions of essential utilities such as electricity, water, or telecommunications; disruptions in the transportation of personnel, equipment, machinery, or materials necessary for the completion of the Project; public health emergencies such as the outbreak or spread of infectious diseases, epidemics, pandemics, or government-imposed lockdowns; adverse economic conditions such as financial crises, default, inflation, currency devaluation, restrictions on capital flows, or unavailability of financing that directly impact the Developer’s ability to perform its obligations; breaches of contract by any essential contractor or subcontractor; or any other matter or cause beyond the Developer’s control that prevents it from fulfilling its obligations under this Agreement. The Developer shall not be held liable for non-completion or non-performance under this Agreement for as long as the Event of Force Majeure persists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Estimated Completion Date, the Developer shall as soon as practicable give the Buyer a revised Estimated Completion Date, as and when it can be determined. Extensions in the Estimated Completion Date on account of an Event of Force Majeure shall be in addition to any other extensions pursuant to the terms hereof. 
 
 No Event of Force Majeure which is less than thirty (30) calendar days shall excuse the Buyer from making any Instalment Payment on its Due Date. Any Event of Force Majeure exceeding thirty (30) days shall result in a commensurate adjustment of the Due Date of any remaining Instalment Payments or any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 
 The Buyer agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Developer against any and all losses, damages, liabilities, claims, and expenses, including any legal fees, arising from any breach of the Buyer’s obligations under this Agreement. This indemnity shall survive the completion and transfer of the Purchased Unit by the Developer to the Buyer . 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Agreement, as defined in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and overrides, supersedes, cancels any   other negotiations, commitments, discussions, representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by the Developer, any officer, agent, employee or representative of the Developer or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, showroom displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Buyer or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Developer, the Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject only to the terms and conditions contained therein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in the Agreement, any modification or amendment to the Agreement shall be in writing duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that he/she will be bound by the Management Agreement and any Building/Community Rules , Fit-Out Manual, regulations and policies that may be applicable from time to time. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 
 The Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to the Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to clause 1 7 .2, the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction. 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940. After the  lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under the Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail, to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in the Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in the case there is more than one Buyer, notice to any one Buyer shall be deemed as notice to all b uyers and the Developer shall be under no obligation to write to each Buyer individually. 
 
 The Buyer shall notify the Developer in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Buyer’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect the  validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Developer to the Buyer at the last known address. 
 
 SURVIVAL 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that the Agreement will survive the Completion Date and transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer and any subsequent buyer. The Agreement shall ensure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assigns. 
 
 The Developer agrees that in case of the death of the Buyer, the Developer shall make reasonable efforts to assist the Nominee named by the Buyer to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Buyer under the Agreement, in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws of inheritance. Provided that the Nominee shall cause all such legal heirs to execute a letter of adherence (or such other document which confirms the legal heirs taking over and being fully bound by the obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement) and indemnify the Developer for any loss or damage on account of claims by the other legal heirs of the Buyer. 
 
 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY 
 
 The Developer may alter the name or logo of the Project at any time at its sole discretion without any notice to the Buyer. 
 
 The Developer shall own and retain all right s , title and interest in and to all and any work product, patent, trademarks, Confidential Information, logo, brand name, trade secret or other data or any other intellectual property of the Developer and nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed to constitute a grant of any license or other right to or in respect thereof. 
 
 TIME IS OF THE  ESSENCE 
 
 With respect to the payments to be made by the Buyer, time shall be of the  essence under this Agreement, except to the extent of any cure periods or periods of delay envisaged in Clause s 1 2 and 2 2 under this Agreement. 
 
 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
 
 Any liability of the Developer arising under or in relation to this Agreement, whether arising under contractual laws, tort or otherwise, shall under no circumstances whatsoever, exceed five per cent (5%) of the total payment(s) received by the Developer from the Buyer. 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 No right or remedy conferred upon or reserved by the Developer under this Agreement is intended to be or shall be deemed to be exclusive of any other right or remedy herein or by law or equity provided or permitted, but each such right or remedy shall be cumulative of every other right or remedy. The Developer’s failure or delay in exercising any right, power or privilege under this Agreement will not operate as a waiver thereof. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 If any one or more provisions of the Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and any documents, data, notices or information disclosed or shared by the Developer, oral or written, shall be regarded as confidential information by the Buyer and the Buyer shall take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties, except where such disclosure is required under any law or court order. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under the Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 The Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 
 The Buyer hereby confirms having read, understood and accepted the Agreement in its entirety and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
